name: effort-guard
description: Claude Code mod: context/token band, escalation signals and per-turn effort log.

threshold.title: Escalation threshold
threshold.description: Consecutive struggling turns before the escalation toast fires.

contextThreshold.title: Context warning (%)
contextThreshold.description: Show a one-off toast when context usage first reaches this percentage. 0 turns it off.

rateLimitThreshold.title: Rate-limit warning (%)
rateLimitThreshold.description: Show a one-off toast when a rate-limit window first reaches this percentage. 0 turns it off.

compactHints.title: Hints for /compact
compactHints.description: Tell the summarizer which command was failing, the narrow rerun and the files changed, so compaction keeps them.

selfCorrect.title: Self-correction prompt
selfCorrect.description: While the struggle streak is at or past the threshold, add a short system-prompt section asking the model to change approach.
